description: The plot illustrates overall ROUGE-4 scores as a function of the number of training examples for several systems and their “5%” variants. The x-axis is labeled “# Training Examples,” uses a linear scale, and shows three discrete tick values at 0, 16, and 64. The y-axis is labeled “Overall ROUGE-4 Score,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 11.0 to 19.0 with evenly spaced tick marks every 2.0 units (11.0, 13.0, 15.0, 17.0, 19.0). A solid green line with circle markers (PELMS) increases from about 16.7 at 0 examples to about 18.4 at 16 and about 18.7 at 64. A dashed green line with circle markers (PELMS (5%)) stays near 16.8 at 0, about 17.0 at 16, and about 17.9 at 64. A solid red line with square markers (Primera) rises from about 15.0 at 0 to about 17.1 at 16 and about 18.1 at 64. A dashed red line with square markers (Primera (5%)) is about 15.0 at 0, dips to about 14.6 at 16, and increases to about 15.8 at 64. A solid blue line with triangle markers (Pegasus-X) increases from about 13.6 at 0 to about 15.5 at 16 and about 17.9 at 64. A dashed blue line with triangle markers (Pegasus-X (5%)) decreases from about 13.6 at 0 to about 11.6 at 16, then increases to about 14.0 at 64. A solid yellow line with diamond markers (Centrum) is about 15.9 at 0, about 16.0 at 16, and about 16.4 at 64. A dashed yellow line with diamond markers (Centrum (5%)) is about 15.9 at 0, about 15.6 at 16, and about 15.9 at 64.
